current.title: Round 54 DELIVERED — the reliability round (second packaged-app session)
current.detail: The owner's second desktop session: 'can't reach agent core' with Restart-engine not recovering it, and after deleting the app folder the launcher said '0.53.0 is current' but 'ACUTE-CODE.exe not found — using the dev-servers flow'. Three root causes fixed: (1) the launcher trusted the NSIS REGISTRY entry, which survives folder deletion — the install is now verified ON DISK (exe + pinned node.exe + sidecar entry) and a broken install is REPAIRED by reinstalling; (2) the packaged app's engine failures were half-blind — agent-core prints its real crash reason to stderr but a GUI process has no stderr handle (Stdio::inherit went nowhere); stderr is now PIPED, drained into sidecar.log, and embedded in the failure error; a failed handshake also KILLED its child now (the old code orphaned a node.exe holding the SQLite DB — the actual mechanism behind 'restart engine didn't work'); the handshake RETRIES (3 attempts, 25s ready budget) before declaring Failed; (3) the offline screen now renders the last 60 sidecar.log lines IN-APP (new sidecar_log_tail shell command) with a Copy-diagnostics button, and the launcher window itself watches sidecar.log after launching the app and prints 'agent-core is up — port N' or the failure tail. Browser-mode folder picking is bounded (2-min abort) with paste-the-path guidance on every failure. cargo check green on the Windows target; launcher helpers logic-tested against the owner's exact scenario; +12 frontend tests.
